svg.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: EnsoGrow task flow
svg.desc: Four tasks drawn as step sequences. Sign in and set up: Google sign-in, then city, dimensions and sunlight, with inline validation if a field is missing, then Gemini recommendations with a retry path. Start growing a plant: browse, pick, view the plan, start growing and add it to the dashboard. Update plant health: choose a status, add notes and save. Diagnose with the plant doctor: camera permission or an upload fallback, capture and confirm a photo with a retake path, send to Gemini, ask follow-up questions if the diagnosis is uncertain, show a cure plan, then save or apply the fix.
